# Invictus Corporate & Legal Consultants (ICLC)

> Premier legal advisory and corporate consultancy firm based in Lahore and Islamabad, Pakistan.

## Firm Overview
Invictus Corporate & Legal Consultants (ICLC) is a high-tier legal advisory and corporate consultancy firm in Pakistan. The firm specializes in corporate governance, civil and criminal litigation, constitutional law, intellectual property, tax advisory, labour compliance, and overseas Pakistani legal representation.

## Contact & Offices

## Practice Areas
- **Corporate & Commercial Advisory**: Company registration with SECP, joint ventures, cross-border contracts, startup legal architecture.
- **Litigation & Dispute Resolution**: Civil litigation, criminal defense, High Court and Supreme Court advocacy, arbitration.
- **Taxation & Regulatory**: FBR income tax, sales tax, corporate withholding audits, Punjab Revenue Authority (PRA).
- **Intellectual Property**: Trademark registration, copyright protection, patent filing via IPO Pakistan.
- **Labour & Employment**: Workforce structuring, Punjab Labour Code compliance, termination protocols.
- **Overseas Pakistanis Representation**: Power of Attorney verification, succession certificates, inheritance recovery.
